flashcard_questions.q: A reaction that can proceed in both the forward and reverse directions, shown by the equilibrium symbol ⇌.
A white solid that breaks down on heating into ammonia gas and hydrogen chloride gas, and reforms when the gases cool.
Copper sulfate crystals that contain water molecules locked into their crystal structure, giving them a blue colour (CuSO₄·5H₂O).
Which symbol in a chemical equation shows that a reaction is reversible?

flashcard_questions.a: The state where the forward and reverse reactions happen at the same rate, so the amounts stay constant.
